title: Modern .NET · eShop
summary: Start with the upstream SDK, Aspire and container prerequisites. This is a multi-service reference app; a frontend-only deploy is incomplete. Pin dependencies, configure synthetic identity/catalog data, and inspect each service required by the chosen checkout flow.

title: ASP.NET Core · monolith
summary: Follow the maintained upstream setup. This is an ASP.NET Core monolith, not classic .NET Framework or Web Forms. Use the exact SDK/database configuration in this source and synthetic catalog data.

title: MERN · React + Express + MongoDB
summary: Use mern/client and mern/server with a dedicated synthetic MongoDB database. Configure ATLAS_URI privately. The source has no backend request-body validation or shared-user isolation; do not expose a mutable shared deployment without addressing those gaps. These missing safeguards can be explicitly disclosed failure lessons.

title: Java · Spring MVC / JSP
summary: Follow upstream build/runtime prerequisites. Older architecture does not imply an unsupported old Java runtime. Compare the same business assertions with the Spring Boot PetClinic track after independently seeding each app.

title: SAP web · Fiori / UI5 / CAP
summary: Use upstream npm install/build guidance. Development mode uses in-memory data and sample credentials; production auth/database configuration is not supplied by the sample. This is a UI5/CAP event app, not ECC, S/4HANA or native SAP GUI. Public multi-user hosting needs its own identity and isolated data.

title: Salesforce · Lightning / LWC
summary: Deploy only into an authorized scratch org, Developer Edition or suitable sandbox following upstream instructions. Configure permission sets and synthetic data. This app runs on Salesforce Platform and cannot be hosted as a complete Salesforce org on Cloud Run.

title: Salesforce · Visualforce → LWC
summary: Use an authorized Salesforce org. Select one of the actual paired Visualforce/LWC patterns in the source before recording. A Visualforce example is not blanket Salesforce Classic coverage; Classic needs its own enabled environment.

title: Next.js · Vercel dashboard
summary: Use dashboard/final-example for the completed course example rather than dashboard/starter-example. Configure the required database and authentication environment privately before Vercel import. Source setup is available; no Vercel deployment has been performed.

title: Node.js / Express API
summary: Use the MERN backend independently. Practice REST CRUD and a disclosed validation gap.

title: Built with Lovable
summary: Bring your published app. Test saved data, invalid input and actual user permissions.

title: Built with Replit

title: SAP ECC / S/4HANA / classic GUI
summary: Use a genuine authorized enterprise sandbox. The public Fiori/CAP sample is not an ERP tenant. Native Windows SAP GUI needs separate runner qualification.
